reviews.text: Francesco conveys expertise, professionalism, and passion not only for truffle hunting but also for walking our beloved dogs. It was a rewarding experience, brimming with advice, anecdotes, and valuable information.

I met Francesco online from our first phone call. He seemed knowledgeable. After 15 days, we spent two hours with my puppies, but he was helpful both for me and for my dogs. He explained all the types of plants and more.

He was an added incentive, he gave me some really important tips to prepare them for truffle hunting. In short, I went home happy with what he had explained and taught me and my dogs.
In addition to being an exquisite and courteous person, over time I have always received excellent advice from him which has allowed me to resolve defects in training and research.

Francesco was able to engage us right away, sharing the secrets of this beautiful tradition with great simplicity and respect for nature.

I met Francesco because I wanted to teach Carlo how to hunt for truffles, and I couldn't have chosen a better guide.

We had several lessons, starting with training with the lead and the truffles used to teach the dog what to look for. Francesco walked us through every step, explaining not only how to work with Carlo, but also many aspects of the world of hunting that I, as a simple enthusiast, would never have known.

The best moment was when we moved on to fieldwork and I saw Carlo find and dig out his first truffle. It was a tremendous thrill, one of those moments you won't easily forget.

Francesco is knowledgeable, helpful, and passionate. He combines his expertise as a dog trainer with extensive experience as a truffle hunter, and he manages to convey both with enthusiasm and simplicity.

For anyone who wants to learn about truffle hunting with their dog, I highly recommend him.

A rare bird in this world!!!! After several experiences with other truffle trainers (not very exciting, to put it mildly), I met Francesco and was immediately struck by his honesty. Unlike others who will do anything to get money from you, he was able to tell me he wouldn't have continued if he didn't think my dog ​​was up to the task. It may seem obvious, but he's the only one I've found willing to give up the money for his morals, so he wouldn't make fun of me. His technical skills, which are unquestionable, are also secondary, but believe me, it's rare to find someone so selfless in this world. Thank you so much from me and Rufi. I can't wait for our second natural encounter. Keep being different from the others and you'll see that everyone will notice you, because honesty always pays off in the long run. Thank you!!!!

I was interested in truffle hunting training for Akira, but in the area I'd only found one-on-one lessons, which were designed to last over time, with no plan or measurable objectives. Luckily, I found Francesco's profile on Facebook, and he phoned me to discuss his training plan, which includes a second section plus online material, along with exam materials for the license.
The experience was amazing, and Akira had a blast. She showed aptitude because the method taught strengthened her hunting skills. Francesco was also available to practice in the woods, which is very difficult to find, and he was committed to providing useful information about the woods for truffle hunters.
Thank you, Francesco, for being the person you are.
